entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Photo time! This is when[n]we were at the food stand!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man. Even yakisoba looks high-[n]class when Haru's eating it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I think this is my first time having[n]yakisoba from a food stand,[n]though.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It was more delicious than[n]I'd imagined!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It was! It wasn't the instant[n]stuff, but still good.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. Dunno why, but food from a[n]stall is always weirdly tasty.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Speakin' of, where are the[n]pictures of us, Ann?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You got pics of us too, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How about the one you took of[n][fName]'s yakisoba? With the[n]big red mountain of ginger?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No, THAT one went straight into[n]the trash. I had dry seaweed all[n]over my teeth!
